graphics.title: STOP: Create Space Before Acting
graphics.mechanism: Interrupt an automatic reaction, notice what is happening, and choose a next action that serves your goals.
graphics.reading: An ink line approaches a pause marked by two bars. A separated green segment resumes toward a small node, expressing a chosen next action after interruption rather than an automatic continuation.

graphics.title: Wise Mind: Bringing Feelings and Facts Together
graphics.mechanism: Make room for emotional experience and practical information together before choosing a response that fits what matters.
graphics.reading: Two overlapping outlines retain their distinct edges. A green center marks the shared area, expressing emotional and reasonable perspectives brought together without one erasing the other.

graphics.title: Identify and Describe Emotions: Understand the Sequence
graphics.mechanism: Describe an emotional episode by distinguishing its context, interpretations, sensations, urges, expressions, and aftereffects.
graphics.reading: Four separate ink and gray elements sit along a loose sequence. An accented element marks a named component. The gaps preserve distinctions among an event, experience, urge, and action without implying a fixed causal order.

graphics.title: Check the Facts: Examine the Story Around the Feeling
graphics.mechanism: Separate what you observed from what you inferred, consider uncertainty, and reassess how an emotion fits the situation.
graphics.reading: A single ink observation branches toward three outlined possibilities. One green return connector highlights comparing possibilities with the observation, rather than automatically selecting a comforting interpretation.

graphics.title: DEAR MAN: Make a Clear Request or Say No
graphics.mechanism: Prepare a clear request or refusal, explain what matters, and stay focused while considering workable options.
graphics.reading: Four ink strokes represent the parts of a prepared message. They align toward a clear green outgoing arrow, expressing an explicit request or refusal with a coherent objective.

graphics.title: Cope Ahead: Rehearse Before the Difficult Moment
graphics.mechanism: Prepare for a foreseeable challenge by choosing concrete responses and rehearsing yourself using them, including a fallback.
graphics.reading: A gray route and a parallel ink route connect the present to a later point. A green detour represents a rehearsed fallback when a difficulty appears. The diagram expresses preparation, not a promised future result.

graphics.title: Opposite Action: Change an Unhelpful Action Urge
graphics.mechanism: Check whether an emotional urge fits the situation, then practise a safe, deliberate alternative when changing that response would help.
graphics.reading: A shared ink starting point leads to a gray branch and a separate green branch in the other direction. The highlighted path represents a chosen safe alternative after checking whether it fits, not a rule that every urge must be reversed.

graphics.title: Self-Soothe: Build a Sensory Toolkit
graphics.mechanism: Explore safe, accessible sensory experiences and keep a small set that offers comfort or steadiness during difficult moments.
graphics.reading: Five separate outlined elements surround an open center. One green element marks a chosen sensory option; the other routes remain available without a requirement to use all senses.

graphics.title: Pros and Cons: Look Beyond the Immediate Urge
graphics.mechanism: Compare the immediate and later effects of acting on an urge and choosing a specific alternative before deciding what to do next.
graphics.reading: Four outlined quadrants hold both sides of two options. A green horizontal arrow beneath them extends the view beyond the immediate moment; no quadrant is marked as an automatic winner.

graphics.title: Validation and Self-Validation: Make Experience Understandable
graphics.mechanism: Acknowledge an experience accurately and recognize what makes sense in context while preserving room for facts, limits, and change.
graphics.reading: An ink element is held within an open gray frame that represents context. A green echo beside it represents accurate acknowledgment while the open boundary leaves room for correction and change.

graphics.title: Radical Acceptance: Acknowledge What Is Here
graphics.mechanism: Acknowledge a present fact you cannot change in this moment, make room for your response, and choose what remains possible.
graphics.reading: An ink block represents a fact already present. A green path begins beside it and moves forward, expressing a response possible from this reality without suggesting approval or erasure of the fact.

graphics.title: Behavior Chain and Solution Analysis: Find Places to Intervene
graphics.mechanism: Examine one difficult episode, trace the events around a specific behavior, and identify practical places to respond differently.
graphics.reading: Three ink nodes linked by gray lines represent a working sequence around a behavior. A green branch from the middle node reaches a separate node, expressing a possible alternative at a specific link. The sequence does not establish causality, and the alternative does not promise an outcome.

graphics.title: Access over Ownership
graphics.mechanism: Organize an offering around use rather than possession.
graphics.reading: A customer stands outside a larger ownership boundary. A green arrow gives the customer access to the small asset inside that boundary; the asset remains enclosed by its owner. The arrow represents a defined right to use, not transfer of ownership. The composition does not require shared use, a subscription, or maintenance services.

graphics.title: Team API
graphics.mechanism: Make a team’s responsibilities, offerings, and interaction expectations explicit and easy for other teams to use.
graphics.reading: An ink frame marks a team’s bounded responsibility. Three green connection points sit on its left boundary, aligned with gray external approaches. Distinct openings express several understandable ways to engage with the team while its internal organization remains bounded; the mark does not require a single compulsory intake channel.

graphics.title: Dependency Mapping
graphics.mechanism: Make cross-unit dependencies explicit so people can see prerequisites, shared constraints, and the consequences of change.
graphics.reading: One green prerequisite at the left feeds two separate ink work units, which both feed a final ink result at the right. Directional links expose how one upstream contribution affects parallel work and their shared outcome. The accent marks shared reliance, not a duration-based critical path or a promise that the contribution is secured.

graphics.title: Boundary Objects
graphics.mechanism: Coordinate through shared artifacts that remain recognizable across groups while supporting their different uses.
graphics.reading: Three distinct ink forms across the top represent different local working perspectives. Gray connectors join all three to one green reference below, with three ink subdivisions preserving recognizable common structure. The accent marks the shared artifact that connects otherwise different forms without making them identical.

graphics.title: Liaison Networks
graphics.mechanism: Connect units through named contacts who exchange context, route questions, and maintain working relationships.
graphics.reading: Three separate ink frames retain distinct unit boundaries. A green contact node sits inside each frame, and gray links connect those named counterparts into a maintained peer network. The distributed nodes express local interfaces with cross-unit relationships rather than a central boss or overlapping governance membership.

graphics.title: Double Linking
graphics.mechanism: Connect two groups through two distinct people who participate in governance decisions in both.
graphics.reading: Two ink frames overlap while retaining distinct outer regions, representing separate group domains. Two green nodes sit inside their shared region: distinct people who belong to both groups and participate in both governance processes. The overlap carries influence through membership rather than directional reporting arrows.

graphics.title: Integrator Roles
graphics.mechanism: Assign a role to reconcile dependencies and tradeoffs across units so their separate contributions form a coherent shared result.
graphics.reading: Three ink specialist units retain gray direct connections. Green branches join their contributions to a separate ink integrator unit below, marking responsibility for their combined fit while preserving the units and their direct relationships. The layout represents coordination rather than reporting lines.

graphics.title: Explicit Escalation Paths
graphics.mechanism: Define when an issue needs wider help or authority, who receives it, how responsibility is accepted, and what happens if it remains unresolved.
graphics.reading: An ink issue unit connects through a green arrow to an ink receiving unit. A gray route reaches a third ink fallback unit above when the ordinary route fails, and a gray return loop beneath carries the outcome back. The accent identifies the explicit ordinary handoff rather than seniority.

graphics.title: Consent Decision-Making
graphics.mechanism: Adopt workable proposals when no qualifying objection remains, using reasoned objections to improve the decision and explicit review to learn from it.
graphics.reading: Three ink units mark proposal, objection check, and adoption, connected by the green route used when objections are resolved. A gray loop runs from the central check through a lower ink revision unit back to the proposal, making improvement and retesting visible rather than treating objections as discarded votes.

graphics.title: Advice Process
graphics.mechanism: Require a decision owner to seek and consider advice from affected people and relevant experts, then decide, explain, and remain accountable for the result.
graphics.reading: Two ink input units stand for affected experience and relevant expertise. Green routes converge on one ink decision-owner unit, while a gray return path beneath the composition represents sharing reasons and learning after the choice. Advice informs ownership without turning into a vote.

graphics.title: Decide Close to the Work
graphics.mechanism: Place decisions with the nearest capable people who can understand their effects, supported by clear authority, timely information, and a route for wider issues.
graphics.reading: Two ink units near the bottom represent the work and its local decision owner, joined by a green direct arrow. A gray route reaches a separate ink unit above for wider authority when required. The accent highlights proximity without removing the alternative route.

graphics.title: Delegated Domains
graphics.mechanism: Give a person or group continuing authority over a defined area of work, with explicit boundaries, resources, dependencies, and review.
graphics.reading: A green boundary encloses three ink decision units joined by gray paths, while an ink delegator above connects to the boundary. The accent identifies the continuing area of entrusted authority: several connected choices can occur inside one remit rather than receiving separate delegations.

graphics.title: Explicit Decision Rights
graphics.mechanism: Specify who prepares, contributes to, authorizes, and carries out important decisions, with clear limits and routes for exceptions.
graphics.reading: Three small ink input units connect through gray branches to a single green authority frame containing an ink decision unit; an ink output below carries the authorized choice into action. The accent marks where the right to settle the question sits, distinct from participation.

graphics.title: Shared Strategic Measures
graphics.mechanism: Choose a small set of measures that units interpret together to judge strategic progress, expose tradeoffs, and adjust their contributions.
graphics.reading: Three distinct ink indicators sit in one common frame. A green return arrow beneath the frame represents interpreting the set together and feeding decisions back into work; gray guides keep the indicators visibly separate rather than collapsing them into one score.

graphics.title: Strategic Guardrails
graphics.mechanism: Make strategic boundaries, decision principles, and review triggers explicit so teams can choose locally without pulling the organization off course.
graphics.reading: Two green rails bound an ink route and a gray alternative branch; different local paths remain possible inside the same strategic limits, without suggesting that every method must be prescribed.

graphics.title: Hoshin Kanri
graphics.mechanism: Turn a few strategic priorities into negotiated commitments across levels and functions, then review results and adjust through a recurring learning cycle.
graphics.reading: Two ink plan units exchange green arrows in both directions, while a gray return path loops below them; commitments are negotiated and then revisited through execution and learning.

graphics.title: Mission Command
graphics.mechanism: Give capable teams a clear intent and bounded authority to adapt their actions as circumstances change, supported by trust and timely information.
graphics.reading: One ink leadership unit connects through gray branches to three ink local units inside a green boundary; shared direction reaches teams whose discretion remains explicitly bounded.

graphics.title: Shared Outcomes
graphics.mechanism: Align separate units around a result they must achieve together, with agreed measures, explicit contributions, and joint priority decisions.
graphics.reading: Three separate ink unit frames connect through gray paths to a single green result above them; the common aim connects distinct contributions while their boundaries remain visible.

graphics.title: Facilitation
graphics.mechanism: Help another team overcome a capability gap while it retains ownership, then reduce assistance as it can proceed for itself.
graphics.reading: A small ink helper unit offers a segmented gray connection toward an intact ink receiving-team frame; green steps remain inside the receiver, expressing capability built without transferring ownership.

graphics.title: X-as-a-Service
graphics.mechanism: Provide a supported capability through a usable interface so other teams can make routine progress without repeated coordination.
graphics.reading: Distinct ink consumer and provider frames connect through a green interface bar; gray connections cross the supported boundary while each unit keeps its own responsibility.

graphics.title: Time-Limited Collaboration
graphics.mechanism: Bring teams into close joint work for a defined discovery goal, then review and deliberately change how they interact.
graphics.reading: Two ink team frames share a green overlap, while a gray time arrow passes a separate ink review mark; the shared effort has a bounded purpose and a decision about what follows.

graphics.title: Complicated-Subsystem Team
graphics.mechanism: Concentrate sustained specialist expertise in a bounded subsystem that other teams can use through a clear, supported interface.
graphics.reading: An ink consumer frame reaches a larger ink subsystem boundary through one gray connection; the green path stays inside the subsystem, concentrating specialist depth behind a limited interface.

graphics.title: Enabling Team
graphics.mechanism: Help teams acquire missing capabilities through focused facilitation, then step back as they become more self-sufficient.
graphics.reading: A green capability marker moves along a gray arrow from an ink specialist unit into a larger ink receiving-team boundary; capability transfers while the receiving team retains its own identity.

graphics.title: Platform Team
graphics.mechanism: Own shared capabilities as an internal product that helps other teams deliver with less complexity and coordination.
graphics.reading: Three ink consumer units connect to one green interface above an ink provider block; the accent highlights a common capability consumed independently by several teams.

graphics.title: Stream-Aligned Team
graphics.mechanism: Give a stable team continuing responsibility for a manageable stream of value, from understanding needs through delivery and operation.
graphics.reading: One ink boundary contains a green flow arrow and its returning feedback path, expressing a stable team carrying work through delivery and learning from operation.

graphics.title: Microenterprise Network
graphics.mechanism: Give small units entrepreneurial responsibility and connect them through explicit agreements, shared capabilities, and common rules.
graphics.reading: Three ink unit frames connect through green horizontal agreements, with gray access links to a common support line; autonomy and visible boundaries coexist with shared capabilities.

graphics.title: Ambidextrous Organization
graphics.mechanism: Run established and exploratory work with different operating arrangements, linked by shared leadership and deliberate resource decisions.
graphics.reading: One ink leadership block connects to a stable ink rectangle and a green open branching form; a gray link preserves connection between established execution and exploratory options.

graphics.title: Front-Back Organization
graphics.mechanism: Connect customer-facing units with shared product capabilities, balancing market needs with reusable offerings and scale.
graphics.reading: Two ink customer units connect across a shared gray junction to three green product units, expressing different market relationships drawing on reusable offerings.

graphics.title: Shared Services
graphics.mechanism: Pool recurring services across organizational units, with clear service ownership and commitments to the units they serve.
graphics.reading: Three ink customer units connect through gray paths to one green provider; the common service supports distinct units without merging their responsibilities.

graphics.title: Federated Organization
graphics.mechanism: Preserve member self-government while giving shared institutions a defined mandate and mutual obligations.
graphics.reading: Three equal ink rings retain distinct boundaries around a green shared institution; gray links connect each member to the common mandate without placing one member above the others.

graphics.title: Matrix Organization
graphics.mechanism: Distribute formal authority across intersecting dimensions and make their shared decisions workable.
graphics.reading: Two ink column heads and two green row heads connect to four intersection nodes; the shared grid expresses distinct functional and project authority meeting at staff assignments.

graphics.title: Divisional Organization
graphics.mechanism: Group capabilities around products, markets, or regions and give each division responsibility for its results.
graphics.reading: A common ink leadership block branches into two outlined business units; each contains three specialist blocks, with green blocks emphasizing that capabilities are brought inside each divisional boundary.

graphics.title: Functional Organization
graphics.mechanism: Group people by specialist discipline and coordinate their contributions across functions.
graphics.reading: Three ink columns group specialist nodes beneath shared leadership; a green lateral connector joins their contributions while the gray branching links retain distinct functional homes.

graphics.title: Build a Web of Goals
graphics.mechanism: Connect recurring activities through shared benefits so they support several purposes with less conflict.
graphics.reading: Three triangular activity modules join at shared goal points; the purple middle module connects the two ink modules into one web.

graphics.title: Satisficing
graphics.mechanism: Define what an acceptable option must provide, then stop searching when one meets that standard.
graphics.reading: The inspected sequence ends at a purple candidate that reaches the ink acceptance boundary; two gray candidates remain beyond that stopping point without being compared.

graphics.title: Obliquity
graphics.mechanism: Pursue complex goals through meaningful activities, learning what matters as you go.
graphics.reading: An ink route visits two activity nodes before approaching an open purple purpose mark; a shorter gray approach ends early, expressing the limits of a direct route to a complex goal.

graphics.title: Define the Core Message
graphics.mechanism: Decide what this audience should take away from this piece before choosing how to emphasize it.
graphics.reading: One statement is selected from several possible ideas and connected to a single accented message block, making the intended takeaway explicit.

graphics.title: Abstract Factory
graphics.mechanism: Create families of compatible products through one coherent creation interface.
graphics.reading: Two compatible pairs emerge from one shared creation boundary.

graphics.title: Abstraction Laddering
graphics.mechanism: Move between the purpose of a goal and concrete ways to achieve it to find a useful problem frame.
graphics.reading: A highlighted middle level connects broader purpose to concrete means.

graphics.title: Act Within Your Discretion
graphics.mechanism: Find a useful next action within the authority, resources, and choices already available to you.
graphics.reading: A next move begins inside the boundary of available authority.

graphics.title: Active Recall
graphics.mechanism: Retrieve knowledge from memory rather than judging learning while the answer is still visible.
graphics.reading: A missing piece is reconstructed from a partially retained structure.

graphics.title: Adapter
graphics.mechanism: Translate an existing interface into the contract a client expects.
graphics.reading: A green intermediary joins a round interface to a square contract.

graphics.title: Anticipate the Moment
graphics.mechanism: Observe movement and behavior so you can prepare before a brief photographic opportunity arrives.
graphics.reading: A gray trajectory and two ink observations lead toward a green future position that can be prepared for.

graphics.title: Apply the Rule to Itself
graphics.mechanism: Examine whether a statement meets the relationship or standard it expresses.
graphics.reading: A rule loops back to inspect the same boundary it defines.

graphics.title: Attack, Then Repair
graphics.mechanism: Challenge a proposal with concrete failure scenarios, then repair it without losing its valuable core.
graphics.reading: A disrupted outline is repaired while its valuable green center remains.

graphics.title: Balancing Feedback Loops
graphics.mechanism: Look for the corrective response and delay that make a system resist change or overshoot a target.
graphics.reading: A return path brings a displaced state back toward a marked target.

graphics.title: Bridge
graphics.mechanism: Separate an abstraction from its implementation so two dimensions can vary independently.
graphics.reading: A stable link connects two dimensions that can each vary independently.

graphics.title: Build Layers
graphics.mechanism: Use foreground, middle ground, and background to communicate depth and relationships.
graphics.reading: Three overlapping planes establish back, middle, and front; green identifies the middle relationship.

graphics.title: Builder
graphics.mechanism: Separate staged construction of a complex result from the result itself.
graphics.reading: Three construction steps accumulate into one assembled result.

graphics.title: Behavioral Activation
graphics.mechanism: Schedule a small, meaningful or rewarding activity rather than waiting for motivation.
graphics.reading: A small scheduled action begins movement without waiting for a larger internal change.

graphics.title: Activity–Mood Monitoring
graphics.mechanism: Record activities alongside mood, energy, pleasure, and mastery to notice useful patterns.
graphics.reading: An activity and an experienced state are recorded as an inspectable pair over time.

graphics.title: Downward Arrow
graphics.mechanism: Gently explore what an automatic thought might mean to uncover a deeper assumption or belief.
graphics.reading: A surface thought is followed downward toward an underlying assumption.

graphics.title: Behavioral Experiment
graphics.mechanism: Test a belief with a small, safe real-world experiment and review what actually happens.
graphics.reading: An expected result and an observed result can be compared after a small test.

graphics.title: Exposure
graphics.mechanism: Plan a gradual approach to a safe, everyday situation you fear or avoid.
graphics.reading: A planned approach proceeds through manageable increases in difficulty.

graphics.title: Graded Task Assignment
graphics.mechanism: Break an overwhelming task into manageable steps and build from a small success.
graphics.reading: A large commitment becomes a sequence of manageable rising steps.

graphics.title: Problem Solving
graphics.mechanism: Define a practical problem, compare options, try one manageable action, and review it.
graphics.reading: A defined problem opens into options and returns to one reviewed action.

graphics.title: Identify Cognitive Distortions
graphics.mechanism: Notice recurring thinking habits—including catastrophizing, mind reading, and discounting the positive.
graphics.reading: A repeated sequence makes one recurring departure from the observations visible.

graphics.title: Thought Record / Cognitive Restructuring
graphics.mechanism: Examine a distressing situation, automatic thoughts, emotions, and evidence to find a more balanced alternative.
graphics.reading: A thought is examined alongside evidence before a balanced alternative is formed.

graphics.title: Worry Time / Stimulus Control for Worry
graphics.mechanism: Give your what-if thoughts space in an adjustable timed writing session.
graphics.reading: A defined time boundary gives concerns a contained place rather than unlimited space.

graphics.title: Chain of Responsibility
graphics.mechanism: Let a request pass through candidate handlers without coupling its sender to a specific receiver.
graphics.reading: A request passes earlier handlers before one handler accepts it.

graphics.title: Change the Frame Size
graphics.mechanism: Vary the time horizon, people considered, or system boundary around an event.
graphics.reading: Two frame sizes expose different amounts of the same underlying situation.

graphics.title: Change Your Position
graphics.mechanism: Move the camera to change viewpoint, overlaps, and the relationships between near and far elements.
graphics.reading: Two ink viewpoints project through one green near element onto different parts of the far gray plane.

graphics.title: Check the Edges
graphics.mechanism: Notice fragments, awkward cuts, and bright distractions where the frame meets the scene.
graphics.reading: An ink frame encloses a quiet center while a green fragment touching its edge calls attention to the boundary.

graphics.title: Choose the Representation Before Solving
graphics.mechanism: Choose a form that reveals the important relationships before asking a model to solve the problem.
graphics.reading: One relationship can be exposed through different representations before proceeding.

graphics.title: Choose Your Depth of Field
graphics.mechanism: Decide how much of the scene needs to appear acceptably sharp, balancing context and isolation.
graphics.reading: A green interval includes two ink depth positions while a third gray position remains outside the chosen sharp range.

graphics.title: Choose Your Subject
graphics.mechanism: Decide what deserves attention, then make the rest of the photograph serve that choice.
graphics.reading: A green subject carries the visual weight while two gray alternatives remain supporting context.

graphics.title: Chunk Down
graphics.mechanism: Unpack a broad judgment into specific components, events, or observations.
graphics.reading: One broad statement opens into several inspectable components.

graphics.title: Chunk Up
graphics.mechanism: Understand a specific method or event as one member of a broader category.
graphics.reading: Specific instances converge into one broader category.

graphics.title: Command
graphics.mechanism: Represent an operation as an object or value so it can be stored, scheduled, or composed.
graphics.reading: An action is enclosed as a transferable object before execution.

graphics.title: Compare How We Experience Collaboration
graphics.mechanism: Examine four dimensions of a working relationship and use differing perceptions as a starting point for inquiry.
graphics.reading: Two distinct perceptions meet across four shared comparison dimensions.

graphics.title: Composite
graphics.mechanism: Give individual objects and groups a common interface for recursive tree operations.
graphics.reading: A group and a leaf share the same square-shaped interface in a recursive tree.

graphics.title: Concept Mapping
graphics.mechanism: Express relationships as meaningful propositions to reveal what a subject’s structure does and does not explain.
graphics.reading: Different ideas are joined by visible relationship spans rather than placed in isolation.

graphics.title: Conflict Resolution Diagram
graphics.mechanism: Separate opposing proposals from the needs and assumptions connecting them to a shared objective.
graphics.reading: Opposing proposals trace back through distinct needs to one shared objective.

graphics.title: Connection Circles
graphics.mechanism: Turn a changing situation into a small set of variables and inspectable causal relationships.
graphics.reading: Variables sit around an implied circle; a dark directional connection stands out among supporting relationships.

graphics.title: Create Your Own Example
graphics.mechanism: Invent and verify new examples and near-misses to test which features of a concept are essential.
graphics.reading: A fresh instance preserves the important structure of an earlier example.

graphics.title: Creative Reframing
graphics.mechanism: Change how a problem is represented before trying to solve it.
graphics.reading: A changed frame reveals a different relationship around the same central element.

graphics.title: Crop with a Purpose
graphics.mechanism: Refine an existing photograph's emphasis, balance, or meaning by deciding what remains inside its boundary.
graphics.reading: An inner ink boundary retains the green subject while the original gray boundary shows what the crop gives up.

graphics.title: Cynefin Framework
graphics.mechanism: Choose a context-appropriate response while remaining open to changes in what kind of situation you face.
graphics.reading: Distinct contexts surround a shared boundary where the response may need to change.

graphics.title: Decision Matrix
graphics.mechanism: Make weighted comparisons inspectable, then test whether the result depends on fragile judgments.
graphics.reading: A highlighted comparison remains visible within a structured set of alternatives.

graphics.title: Decorator
graphics.mechanism: Compose optional responsibilities by wrapping an object behind the same contract.
graphics.reading: Nested wrappers add responsibilities around an unchanged green core.

graphics.title: Define the Decision Before Comparing Options
graphics.mechanism: Clarify the desired outcome and genuine constraints before judging alternatives.
graphics.reading: A clear outcome boundary is established before alternatives enter it.

graphics.title: Design Participation Before the Agenda
graphics.mechanism: Connect each meeting step to a purpose, invitation, participation arrangement, and useful output.
graphics.reading: A shared purpose connects to a participation arrangement before the final output.

graphics.title: Double Standard Technique
graphics.mechanism: Offer yourself the same fairness you would offer someone you care about.
graphics.reading: The same measure is applied fairly to two separate cases.

graphics.title: Draw on a Wider Circle of Help
graphics.mechanism: Receive consultation from a central group while drawing on observations from a wider circle.
graphics.reading: A central consultation draws on contributions from a wider ring.

graphics.title: Drill the Bottleneck
graphics.mechanism: Find the narrow component limiting your performance, practice it deliberately, then reintegrate it into the whole.
graphics.reading: The green waist identifies the narrow component that limits the wider process and deserves focused practice.

graphics.title: Edit to Guide Attention
graphics.mechanism: Adjust brightness, contrast, and color to support a clear intention while respecting the photograph's context.
graphics.reading: A green change in visual weight directs attention to the ink subject while smaller gray forms retain supporting context.

graphics.title: Eisenhower Matrix
graphics.mechanism: Distinguish urgency from importance before deciding what deserves attention and protected time.
graphics.reading: One quadrant receives deliberate attention within two independent dimensions.

graphics.title: Enact a Possibility Before Committing
graphics.mechanism: Try a short scene to expose practical details, then recombine useful moves into another attempt.
graphics.reading: A short trial is revised and attempted again before a final commitment.

graphics.title: Exchange Ideas Through Rotating Stations
graphics.mechanism: Use repeated small exchanges to understand initiatives, ask better questions, and discover useful connections.
graphics.reading: Small encounters move between distinct stations around a shared circuit.

graphics.title: Explore the Rule of Thirds
graphics.mechanism: Try thirds as one placement strategy, and compare it with a centered composition.
graphics.reading: A green point sits at a thirds intersection inside an ink boundary; the center remains an available alternative.

graphics.title: Expose for What Matters
graphics.mechanism: Prioritize important tones when a scene's brightness range requires a compromise.
graphics.reading: Dark and gray tonal regions compete; a green boundary reserves attention for the small important region.

graphics.title: Facade
graphics.mechanism: Offer a focused interface over a subsystem with several collaborating components.
graphics.reading: One clear entry provides access to several collaborating components.

graphics.title: Factory Method
graphics.mechanism: Let a reusable workflow delegate object creation to an overridable method.
graphics.reading: A stable workflow delegates its creation step through one distinct extension point.

graphics.title: Fade the Worked Example
graphics.mechanism: Gradually remove support from a complete model until you can perform the task independently.
graphics.reading: Supporting structure gradually recedes as independent performance becomes the focus.

graphics.title: Feynman Technique
graphics.mechanism: Explain an idea in your own words to discover where terminology is hiding gaps in understanding.
graphics.reading: A dense representation is unpacked into clear parts, exposing one gap.

graphics.title: Find a Relationship
graphics.mechanism: Make a connection, contrast, or juxtaposition between elements the reason for the photograph.
graphics.reading: A green connection makes the relationship between a round and a square element the main event.

graphics.title: Find an Analogy
graphics.mechanism: Use a structurally similar relationship in another domain to clarify the original problem.
graphics.reading: The same relationship is carried between two different representations.

graphics.title: Find Soft Light
graphics.mechanism: Seek broad apparent light sources when gradual shadow transitions suit the subject.
graphics.reading: A broad green source sends paths toward the same ink subject from several angles, producing a gentler transition.

graphics.title: Find the Conditions Behind Success
graphics.mechanism: Reconstruct a successful episode and investigate the conditions worth supporting or testing elsewhere.
graphics.reading: A useful outcome is traced back to the enabling conditions beneath it.

graphics.title: Find the Frame, Then Wait
graphics.mechanism: Hold a useful composition while an event supplies the missing relationship.
graphics.reading: An ink boundary and gray structure stay fixed while a green arriving element supplies the missing relationship.

graphics.title: Find the Positive Intention
graphics.mechanism: Separate an understandable concern from the strategy currently used to protect it.
graphics.reading: An outer strategy is separated from the protected concern at its center.

graphics.title: First-principles Thinking
graphics.mechanism: Rebuild a solution from established requirements and constraints after separating them from inherited conventions.
graphics.reading: A new arrangement is rebuilt from a small set of retained foundations.

graphics.title: Flyweight
graphics.mechanism: Share reusable intrinsic state while keeping context-specific state outside the shared object.
graphics.reading: Several separate contexts connect to the same reusable green core.

graphics.title: Focus on What Matters
graphics.mechanism: Select the intended subject or distance instead of accepting an accidental autofocus target.
graphics.reading: Ink focus boundaries isolate the intended green target while outlying gray points remain outside that choice.

graphics.title: Follow the Consequences
graphics.mechanism: Examine the behavior and downstream effects encouraged by a belief or rule.
graphics.reading: A belief leads through behavior to a visible downstream effect.

graphics.title: Follow the Light
graphics.mechanism: Observe where light comes from and choose the relationship between light, subject, and camera.
graphics.reading: A green source reaches an ink subject from one side; a gray continuation records the resulting directional relationship.

graphics.title: Freeze or Show Motion
graphics.mechanism: Choose how movement should appear, distinguishing subject motion, camera shake, and panning.
graphics.reading: An isolated ink instant contrasts with an extended green movement trace, making duration a visible choice.

graphics.title: Generate Before Looking
graphics.mechanism: Make a brief prediction or attempt before revealing the answer so that information becomes feedback.
graphics.reading: An initial attempt appears before the separate boundary revealing the answer.

graphics.title: Give People Something to Do
graphics.mechanism: Offer a comfortable activity that gives hands, attention, and expression somewhere natural to go.
graphics.reading: Two ink participants direct attention into a shared green activity instead of toward an external demand to perform.

graphics.title: Hard Choice Model
graphics.mechanism: Match the way you deliberate to the stakes and how meaningfully the alternatives can be compared.
graphics.reading: Two difficult alternatives are compared against two separate dimensions.

graphics.title: Iceberg Model
graphics.mechanism: Connect a visible event with recurring patterns, enabling structures, and assumptions worth examining.

graphics.mechanism: Narrow a choice deliberately so you can explore the remaining possibilities more deeply.
graphics.reading: An ink boundary restricts the available field while a green branching route explores the choices still open inside it.

graphics.title: Use Backlight
graphics.mechanism: Put light behind the subject to explore transmission, luminous edges, atmosphere, or silhouettes.
graphics.reading: A green source lies behind the ink subject relative to a gray viewpoint, with green edges carrying its separation.

graphics.title: Use Contrast, Not Just Examples
graphics.mechanism: Pair the desired result with a nearby but wrong example to make subtle boundaries visible.
graphics.reading: A correct structure sits beside a near miss with the important difference highlighted.

graphics.title: Use Leading Lines
graphics.mechanism: Use visible or implied lines to connect important elements and organize attention.
graphics.reading: Converging ink paths organize attention around one green destination rather than ending without a relationship.

graphics.title: Use Negative Space
graphics.mechanism: Give relatively empty areas a deliberate role in emphasis, atmosphere, and scale.
graphics.reading: An otherwise open ink frame gives one small green element room and disproportionate emphasis.

graphics.title: Use Symmetry
graphics.mechanism: Align mirrored or repeated arrangements to create balance, order, and purposeful interruptions.
graphics.reading: Paired ink forms balance across a gray axis while one green interruption makes the established order visible.

graphics.title: Visitor
graphics.mechanism: Organize operations separately from a stable family of element types using type-specific dispatch.
graphics.reading: One external operation visits a stable set of different element types.

graphics.title: Work the Scene
graphics.mechanism: Develop a photograph through deliberate variations while you are still with the subject.
graphics.reading: Four stable ink boundaries contain deliberately different green placements rather than repeating the first answer.

graphics.title: Work With Enduring Tensions
graphics.mechanism: Hold two legitimate demands together and look for arrangements that respect both.
graphics.reading: Two legitimate demands remain distinct while a shared bridge holds them together.

graphics.title: Zwicky Box
graphics.mechanism: Generate structurally different possibilities by combining alternatives across independent dimensions.
graphics.reading: Selections across independent dimensions combine into a new configuration.

graphics.title: Check What the Model Misses
graphics.mechanism: Compare predictions and replicated data with observations to find consequential structure a fitted model fails to represent.
graphics.reading: Observed and replicated traces separate at one consequential feature, revealing a model mismatch.

graphics.title: Choose the Unit of Assignment
graphics.mechanism: Align treatment assignment, spillover boundaries, outcome measurement, and analysis before running an experiment.
graphics.reading: Two highlighted group boundaries align the intervention with the units that are assigned and analyzed.

graphics.title: Check That the Measure Matches the Claim
graphics.mechanism: Support the intended interpretation of a score with evidence about what it includes, omits, and confounds.
graphics.reading: A score captures one highlighted part of a broader construct, making coverage and omissions visible.

graphics.title: Monitor Against a Stable Baseline
graphics.mechanism: Define a credible baseline and a prospective signal rule before interpreting changes in a running process.
graphics.reading: A process fluctuates within baseline limits before a highlighted prospective threshold crossing.

graphics.title: Plan for Useful Precision
graphics.mechanism: Choose a study size and recruitment plan from the uncertainty, outcome variation, and comparison the decision actually requires.
graphics.reading: Uncertainty intervals narrow toward a chosen precision target as study information increases.

graphics.title: Test for Practical Equivalence
graphics.mechanism: Define meaningful difference bounds in advance and assess whether the evidence rules out differences beyond them.
graphics.reading: An entire uncertainty interval lies inside the prespecified region of practically negligible differences.

graphics.title: Resample Whole Units
graphics.mechanism: Match resampling to the units, pairing, strata, and dependence that generated the observations.
graphics.reading: Paired blocks stay together across repeated samples rather than breaking their generating structure.

graphics.title: Update Beliefs with Evidence
graphics.mechanism: Combine an explicit prior and observation model with new evidence, then examine how the assumptions influence the posterior.
graphics.reading: A prior curve and likelihood combine into a narrower highlighted posterior between them.

graphics.title: Answer the Strongest Objection
graphics.mechanism: Address a reasonable challenge that could materially change the argument, revising or withdrawing the position when the challenge succeeds.
graphics.reading: A material challenge meets the claim directly and changes the argument that follows.

graphics.title: Break an Established Form for Emphasis
graphics.mechanism: Establish a recognizable verbal or grammatical form, then depart from it where the change should draw attention.
graphics.reading: A conspicuous departure draws attention only after the repeated form is established.

graphics.title: Build Around a Governing Question
graphics.mechanism: Give a larger piece a central uncertainty or inquiry that explains why its parts belong together and what their development helps the reader understand.
graphics.reading: A central inquiry gives distinct sections a reason to belong to one piece.

graphics.title: Capture Material Before You Need It
graphics.mechanism: Preserve retrievable particulars and their sources while they are available, so later writing can use them without turning vague memory into invented detail.
graphics.reading: Particular observations and their sources are gathered into a retrievable store for later writing.

graphics.title: Choose Terms the Reader Can Use
graphics.mechanism: Match vocabulary to the reader's task, and make necessary specialist terms understandable where they enter the explanation.
graphics.reading: A specialist term connects to a usable explanation at the point the reader needs it.

graphics.title: Choose the Specific Word
graphics.mechanism: Name the distinction that matters, using no more precision than the reader needs or the evidence supports.
graphics.reading: Broad alternatives narrow to the one distinction the passage needs.

graphics.title: Choose the Telling Detail
graphics.mechanism: Select a particular that reveals something important about this subject, instead of relying on stock description or an inventory of features.
graphics.reading: One revealing particular is selected from a wider inventory of descriptive material.

graphics.title: Connect Evidence to the Claim
graphics.mechanism: Explain why the evidence bears on this conclusion, making the inference and any necessary assumption available for the reader to examine.
graphics.reading: An explicit inferential bridge connects concrete evidence to the conclusion it supports.

graphics.title: Control Narrative Distance
graphics.mechanism: Choose how closely the narration follows immediate experience, and move toward or away from it for a reason the passage can carry.
graphics.reading: Nested frames move from the whole situation toward immediate experience.

graphics.title: Cut Redundancy
graphics.mechanism: Remove repeated meaning that adds no useful development, while retaining repetition that supports clarity, rhythm, or emotion.
graphics.reading: A repeated middle line is removed while the remaining lines carry the thought.

graphics.title: Engage the Relevant Senses
graphics.mechanism: Choose sensory information that makes the observer's physical situation and attention available to the reader.
graphics.reading: Relevant sensory particulars converge on the perceiver situated at the center.

graphics.title: Enter Late and Leave Early
graphics.mechanism: Set a scene or section's boundaries near the material that gives it purpose, while preserving the orientation, anticipation, and aftermath that matter.
graphics.reading: The selected scene boundaries retain the purposeful interval and compress routine approach and departure.

graphics.title: Enter the Conversation Fairly
graphics.mechanism: Represent the relevant existing position accurately enough that readers can understand what the new contribution answers, extends, or disputes.
graphics.reading: Two existing positions are made legible before a new contribution joins their conversation.

graphics.title: Explain What Is at Stake
graphics.mechanism: Show what understanding, choice, or consequence depends on the argument, and for whom that difference matters.
graphics.reading: An argument connects to a consequence that makes the difference matter to someone.

graphics.title: Filter Through the Viewpoint
graphics.mechanism: Select the details a particular perceiver can know and would have reason to notice, rather than presenting the writer's complete inventory.
graphics.reading: A perceiver filters a broad available field into a selected account.

graphics.title: Give Each Paragraph a Main Job
graphics.mechanism: Shape a paragraph so its details contribute to a recognizable purpose, and use the break to mark a meaningful change.
graphics.reading: A shared boundary gathers several lines around one paragraph purpose.

graphics.title: Give the Scene a Want
graphics.mechanism: Make a person's immediate desire, intention, or pressing concern legible so readers can understand what matters within the scene.
graphics.reading: An immediate goal gives a person direction through the scene.

graphics.title: Introduce Backstory When It Changes the Present
graphics.mechanism: Place past information where it helps readers understand an active situation, while allowing the past its own space when that is the story being told.
graphics.reading: Past information enters where it changes the reader’s understanding of an active present.

graphics.title: Keep Speech Attribution Clear and Light
graphics.mechanism: Identify speakers where readers need the help, using simple tags and relevant action without making attribution compete with the exchange.
graphics.reading: Small consistent speaker marks keep the exchange identifiable without competing with it.

graphics.title: Keep Subjects and Verbs Close
graphics.mechanism: Move burdensome interruptions away from the subject–verb connection while preserving the qualifications the sentence needs.
graphics.reading: The subject and verb share a short direct connection while qualifying material moves below.

graphics.title: Let a Motif Change Meaning
graphics.mechanism: Return to an image, object, sound, phrase, or situation in changed circumstances so recurrence develops a relationship rather than simply repeating a signal.
graphics.reading: A recurring form remains recognizable while changed circumstances alter its significance.

graphics.title: Let Dialogue Carry Subtext
graphics.mechanism: Make an unspoken concern perceptible through the relationship between words, circumstances, and responses, while giving the reader enough to infer it.
graphics.reading: Visible words sit above an inferred concern made available by the surrounding situation.

graphics.title: Let the Scene Change Something
graphics.mechanism: Identify what readers carry into and out of a scene, and make the consequential change in knowledge, options, relationship, or understanding available on the page.
graphics.reading: The state at the scene ending differs visibly from the state at its opening.

graphics.title: Let the Verb Do the Work
graphics.mechanism: Choose an accurate verb and keep only the modifiers that contribute meaning, emphasis, or voice.
graphics.reading: The central action bears the weight while peripheral modifiers remain small.

graphics.title: Make Abstractions Tangible
graphics.mechanism: Connect a general idea to an inspectable situation, then explain what the example reveals and where its reach ends.
graphics.reading: A general idea connects to a bounded concrete example that can be inspected.

graphics.title: Make Dialogue an Action
graphics.mechanism: Let a speech turn pursue something and alter the possibilities of the exchange, whether through resistance, cooperation, or a changed understanding.
graphics.reading: One speech turn changes the possibilities for the reply that follows.

graphics.title: Make Events Cause Events
graphics.mechanism: Connect developments through consequences, responses, and changed conditions so that later events arise intelligibly from what came before.
graphics.reading: Each development changes the conditions that produce the next.

graphics.title: Make References Unambiguous
graphics.mechanism: Keep the people, objects, ideas, and voices in a passage identifiable as the wording moves between them.
graphics.reading: Each later reference connects to one clearly identifiable earlier referent.

graphics.title: Make Resistance Matter
graphics.mechanism: Let a constraint, incompatible aim, or meaningful cost change what pursuing a want requires, rather than merely postponing its fulfilment.
graphics.reading: An opposing constraint forces the pursuit to change its route rather than merely wait.

graphics.title: Make the Main Claim Findable
graphics.mechanism: State the position or proposed answer clearly enough that readers can distinguish it from the topic, the question, and the material offered in support.
graphics.reading: The principal claim stands apart from supporting material and remains easy to locate.

graphics.title: Make Viewpoint Shifts Legible
graphics.mechanism: Orient readers when the perspective organizing a passage changes, so knowledge and interpretation remain attached to the intended person or narrator.
graphics.reading: An explicit transition orients the reader as the organizing perspective changes.

graphics.title: Manage the Reader's Questions
graphics.mechanism: Give readers enough information to recognize a meaningful uncertainty, then let answers and discoveries develop the questions that carry their attention.
graphics.reading: A prepared uncertainty opens a route through successive information toward an answer.

graphics.title: Match the Claim to the Evidence
graphics.mechanism: Adjust a conclusion's scope, confidence, and conditions to what the available evidence supports, without weakening bounded facts that are established.
graphics.reading: The claim stays within the visible bounds supported by the evidence.

graphics.title: Move from Familiar to New
graphics.mechanism: Give readers an identifiable connection to what they already understand before introducing the next unfamiliar idea.
graphics.reading: A visible connection carries the reader from an established block to a new block of information.

graphics.title: Punctuate for Pace and Meaning
graphics.mechanism: Choose punctuation that makes the relationship between parts legible and gives the sentence an appropriate movement.
graphics.reading: Punctuation makes a short pause and a longer turn visible within the flow.

graphics.title: Put Actors in Subjects and Actions in Verbs
graphics.mechanism: Make important actors and actions visible instead of burying them inside abstract nouns and impersonal constructions.
graphics.reading: An identifiable actor connects directly to an action instead of hiding behind an impersonal boundary.

graphics.title: Put Weight at the End
graphics.mechanism: Let a sentence or paragraph arrive at the information that deserves emphasis, without burying an answer or stripping away a necessary qualification.
graphics.reading: A line arrives at a visually heavier final unit where the emphasis belongs.

graphics.title: Read Aloud to Hear the Draft
graphics.mechanism: Use an audible reading to notice phrasing, repetition, pacing, and missing connections that familiar silent reading may overlook, then investigate what needs revision.
graphics.reading: Written phrasing becomes audible so rhythm, repetition, and missing connections can be noticed.

graphics.title: Read Like a Writer
graphics.mechanism: Connect an effect you experience while reading to observable choices in the text, then test a comparable move in original material.
graphics.reading: A noticed reading effect connects to a craft choice that can be tested in new writing.

graphics.title: Remove Explanatory Echoes
graphics.mechanism: Remove commentary that restates an implication the passage already makes available, while retaining context, interpretation, and voice that add something.
graphics.reading: A redundant interpretive echo is crossed out after the passage has already made its meaning available.

graphics.title: Repeat with a Purpose
graphics.mechanism: Let repeated wording add orientation, contrast, rhythm, or pressure as the surrounding thought develops.
graphics.reading: A repeated opening anchors successive lines while their contribution develops.

graphics.title: Reveal Character Through Choice
graphics.mechanism: Make a consequential decision reveal priorities, contradictions, or change by establishing what the person knows, what alternatives are available, and what choosing costs.
graphics.reading: A visible decision selects one consequential alternative and reveals a priority.

graphics.title: Reverse-Outline the Draft
graphics.mechanism: Describe what the existing units of a draft actually do, so repetition, missing steps, and mismatches between the promised and delivered work become visible.
graphics.reading: Existing draft units map outward to a compact account of what each actually does.

graphics.title: Revise from Structure to Sentences
graphics.mechanism: Give purpose, selection, development, and arrangement priority over extensive polishing when larger changes may alter or remove the prose being edited.
graphics.reading: Revision proceeds from the larger arrangement toward local sentence detail.

graphics.title: Seek Feedback Against the Intended Effect
graphics.mechanism: Ask suitable readers where their understanding, attention, or response changed, then use those accounts to choose revisions that serve the work's purpose.
graphics.reading: A draft reaches a reader and a specific account of its effect returns to guide revision.

graphics.title: Separate Drafting from Editing
graphics.mechanism: When evaluation blocks discovery, give generating material and judging it distinguishable periods of attention, returning to assessment once there is something useful to assess.
graphics.reading: Different periods of attention allow generation before deliberate assessment.

graphics.title: Separate the Record from the Interpretation
graphics.mechanism: Make clear what comes from observation, documents, reported accounts, memory, or inference, so readers can assess the basis of consequential statements.
graphics.reading: Distinct columns distinguish what is recorded from what is inferred.

graphics.title: Set Up and Pay Off
graphics.mechanism: Prepare a detail, capability, or expectation before its later significance so the development feels understandable and earned.
graphics.reading: An early prepared detail travels forward to a later moment that gives it significance.

graphics.title: Show What Matters, Summarize the Rest
graphics.mechanism: Expand consequential moments into concrete experience and compress intervals whose purpose is to connect or contextualize them.
graphics.reading: A consequential moment expands into detail between two compressed connecting intervals.

graphics.title: Signal the Real Relationship
graphics.mechanism: Use transitions, syntax, and explicit connections to show how statements relate, without claiming more than the reasoning supports.
graphics.reading: A visible directional connection states how two claims actually relate.

graphics.title: Use Metaphor to Reveal a Relationship
graphics.mechanism: Choose a comparison for the relationship it makes available, and notice which assumptions it imports or leaves out.
graphics.reading: A relational bridge links selected features across two distinct domains.

graphics.title: Use Parallel Form for Related Ideas
graphics.mechanism: Give related ideas comparable grammatical shapes so readers can follow the intended comparison without mistaking verbal balance for equal evidence.
graphics.reading: Comparable grammatical frames align related ideas for comparison.

graphics.title: Vary Sentence Length Deliberately
graphics.mechanism: Change sentence length and complexity to shape continuity, emphasis, and shifts in thought, rather than following a fixed alternation.
graphics.reading: Different line lengths create deliberate changes of pace and a final point of emphasis.

graphics.title: Write Toward a Reader and an Effect
graphics.mechanism: Choose a plausible reader and an intended experience or change in understanding, so decisions about material, form, and explanation have a purpose to serve.
graphics.reading: A draft is directed toward an identifiable reader and an intended effect.

graphics.title: Protect the Song's Identity
graphics.mechanism: Identify the relationship that makes the song recognizable and preserve it while other material changes.
graphics.reading: A central connected gesture remains accented while two surrounding realizations change their shapes.

graphics.title: Set the Pace for the Phrase
graphics.mechanism: Choose tempo by singing the phrase, then adjust activity separately from the underlying pace.
graphics.reading: Equally spaced reference beats support both sparse and dense event rows without moving the pulse.

graphics.title: Group the Beat Around the Phrase
graphics.mechanism: Choose a recurring beat grouping that supports the phrase's accents and return points.
graphics.reading: Six small events are grouped as three pairs above and two groups of three below.

graphics.title: Make Space Part of the Rhythm
graphics.mechanism: Place and count silences as deliberately as notes so the next entrance has room to speak.
graphics.reading: An initial sustained block ends early, leaving a marked empty span before the next accented entrance.

graphics.title: Pull an Entrance Across the Beat
graphics.mechanism: Move one entrance against a clear beat reference to create a pickup, a push, or a delayed confirmation.
graphics.reading: One upper event precedes the reference boundary while the lower event confirms that boundary.

graphics.title: Give the Groove a Consistent Feel
graphics.mechanism: Choose a repeatable timing relationship between parts instead of scattering random timing changes.
graphics.reading: A stable lower reference accompanies a consistently shifted upper pattern rather than progressively drifting attacks.

graphics.title: Intervals and Melodic Shape
graphics.mechanism: Track the distances and directions between notes so a melodic gesture survives a new starting pitch.
graphics.reading: Two stepped gestures at different heights preserve the same horizontal spans and vertical distances.

graphics.title: Establish a Tonal Home
graphics.mechanism: Make a pitch feel like home through bass, repetition, and phrase endings, then choose the surrounding palette.
graphics.reading: Several moving paths return to one accented low reference, making a home through repeated arrivals.

graphics.title: Choose Chords by Their Notes
graphics.mechanism: Inspect the chord tones beneath a fixed melody before replacing a familiar chord shape.
graphics.reading: Three chord members stay visible while only the middle member changes its pitch level.

graphics.title: Think in Chord Numbers
graphics.mechanism: Describe roots and chord qualities relative to a tonal center while keeping durations explicit.
graphics.reading: A three-column relationship remains aligned while the second row moves together to a new pitch level.

graphics.title: Transpose the Song to Fit the Voice
graphics.mechanism: Move melody and harmony together to a pitch level that suits the intended performer.
graphics.reading: A complete connected shape moves upward by one constant distance, retaining its internal relationships.

graphics.title: Decide Where the Harmony Arrives
graphics.mechanism: Coordinate chord order, change rate, and phrase endings to make a passage settle, stay open, or continue.
graphics.reading: Two paths approach the same boundary: one stops at the accented destination while the other continues onward.

graphics.title: Give the Melody a Destination
graphics.mechanism: Reserve a contour change or register peak for the phrase that deserves the listener's attention.
graphics.reading: An otherwise modest contour reserves a single accented high point before returning to the middle region.

graphics.title: Support or Challenge the Melody Note
graphics.mechanism: Keep a melodic note fixed while comparing harmony that settles it, colors it, or delays its resolution.
graphics.reading: One fixed upper note meets two different lower chord structures, with its supported alignment accented.

graphics.title: Let the Phrase Breathe
graphics.mechanism: Give a musical sentence enough sounding time and enough space to make its next entrance clear.
graphics.reading: Two sounding spans are separated by a generous marked gap before the second phrase begins.

graphics.title: Let Sound Support the Lyric
graphics.mechanism: Choose rhyme and vowel relationships that reinforce the speaker's thought without forcing the wording.
graphics.reading: Different line beginnings lead to related accented endings, preserving a sound relationship without identical text.

graphics.title: Make Speech and Melody Agree
graphics.mechanism: Place musical emphasis where the sung sentence needs it, revising either words or notes when they conflict.
graphics.reading: Word-like spans and melody-like peaks align at the same two accented positions.

graphics.title: Connect Chords with Small Moves
graphics.mechanism: Keep useful common tones and move the remaining voices deliberately while giving the bass its own path.
graphics.reading: Two chord voices stay level while a third takes a small step; a separate low line moves independently.

graphics.title: Add Color to a Working Chord
graphics.mechanism: Add or replace one chord tone under a fixed phrase, keeping the color only when its relationship helps.
graphics.reading: A stable three-note frame gains one accented upper member while its original structure remains visible.

graphics.title: Change the Tonal World Deliberately
graphics.mechanism: Choose whether to keep the center, change its surrounding palette, or establish a new home during the song.
graphics.reading: An upper palette changes over a fixed low center before a separate passage establishes a new center.

graphics.title: Give Each Section a Purpose
graphics.mechanism: Describe what a section contributes to the listening experience before choosing its label or adding another one.
graphics.reading: Three section spans have different internal contributions while remaining joined in one sequence.

graphics.title: Choose a Form That Serves the Song
graphics.mechanism: Arrange returns and departures around the material's central experience instead of filling a default section template.
graphics.reading: A recurring accented span returns between two distinct connecting spans, showing a choice of whole-song order.

graphics.title: Shape the Approach and the Ending
graphics.mechanism: Adjust the time before an arrival, the event that joins it, and the final gesture so the song's attention stays directed.
graphics.reading: A measured approach leads to one accented arrival and a deliberately short ending.

graphics.title: Choose the World Around the Song
graphics.mechanism: Select a coherent sound setting that exposes the writing's essential relationships.
graphics.reading: The same accented central gesture is heard within two different surrounding frames.

graphics.title: Let the Voice Carry the Meaning
graphics.mechanism: Choose delivery and backing voices around the lead sentence's meaning, adding layers selectively.
graphics.reading: An uninterrupted lead contour stays in front while two selective lower voices enter only near its end.

graphics.title: Think–Pair–Share
graphics.mechanism: Give every learner time to form an idea before comparing reasons and contributing to a discussion.
graphics.reading: An independent point branches into two participants and reconnects as a shared contribution. Green identifies the idea developed for the wider group.

graphics.title: Jigsaw Learning
graphics.mechanism: Prepare complementary contributions with expert peers, then teach one another and connect the whole topic.
graphics.reading: Four distinct contributions connect to a common center. Green identifies the integrated account that requires all four pieces.

graphics.title: Snowball Groups
graphics.mechanism: Develop individual ideas through progressively larger conversations while preserving important disagreements.
graphics.reading: One contribution develops through a pair and a quartet. A separate green route carries an unresolved question forward alongside the larger group.

graphics.title: Peer Instruction
graphics.mechanism: Use independent answers, peer reasoning, and reconsideration to reveal and examine conceptual understanding.
graphics.reading: Different initial answers converge on a shared examination before a revised answer. The returning curve marks reconsideration; green identifies the new judgment.

graphics.title: Think-Aloud Pair Problem Solving
graphics.mechanism: Make problem-solving decisions audible through complementary solver and listener roles that exchange between tasks.
graphics.reading: A branching solution path faces an open listening frame. Opposing connectors exchange their responsibilities; green highlights the decision made available for examination.

graphics.title: Gallery Walk
graphics.mechanism: Examine work beyond the original group, contribute specific feedback, and return to connect and revise ideas.
graphics.reading: Three external work stations feed observations into a revised central representation. Green marks the connection added through examining other groups work.

graphics.title: Fishbowl Discussion
graphics.mechanism: Give observers a focused task, reflect on specific discussion moments, and use that reflection in the next exchange.
graphics.reading: An inner conversation sits inside an observing ring. The green route connects a focused observation back to the next exchange.

graphics.title: Structured Academic Controversy
graphics.mechanism: Understand and represent competing cases before developing a justified judgment from the available evidence.
graphics.reading: Two contrasting positions exchange places before their evidence converges on a judgment. Green follows one perspective through the reversal and into reconsideration.

graphics.title: Design for the Audience
graphics.mechanism: Adapt language, information priority, and presentation to people's knowledge, tasks, and viewing conditions.
graphics.reading: Three different constraint profiles connect to corresponding adjusted message forms. Green marks the matched forms; each preserves a different arrangement rather than assuming one treatment fits every situation.

graphics.title: Match Form to Purpose
graphics.mechanism: Choose a structure and format that let people use the information for the task the design must support.
graphics.reading: One content block branches toward an ordered stack, aligned grid and segmented strip. Green marks different usable structures selected according to the task, rather than a single format imposed on every encounter.

graphics.title: Remove the Nonessential
graphics.mechanism: Remove elements that do not earn their place in this encounter while preserving meaning, identity, and necessary conditions.
graphics.reading: Three content-bearing bars survive at their original levels while interleaved gray marks disappear. Green identifies retained material, emphasizing selective removal rather than stripping everything away.

graphics.title: Make Meaning Explicit
graphics.mechanism: State the relationship, scope, or consequence that a viewer would otherwise have to infer from an ambiguous design.
graphics.reading: Two different forms connect directly to their own explanation blocks. Green marks the explanations that make each mapping explicit, instead of leaving the meaning of the visible forms to inference.

graphics.title: Chunk Information
graphics.mechanism: Organize material into useful units so readers can locate a part, understand what belongs together, and handle detail without reconstructing the structure.
graphics.reading: The same six bars remain on both sides. On the right, wider gaps and green brackets express three paired content units. Grouping changes relationships without deleting detail; three pairs illustrate this case rather than prescribing a universal group count.

graphics.title: Sequence the Message
graphics.mechanism: Arrange content so readers encounter context, dependencies, and supporting detail in an order suited to what they need to understand or do.
graphics.reading: A triangle, square and circle remain intact while their vertical order changes. The green connector follows the reordered column from top to bottom. The different forms represent content units, not a prescribed universal sequence.

graphics.title: Establish a Clear Reading Order
graphics.mechanism: Make the intended route through content apparent through sequence cues, continuity, and layouts that preserve meaningful order across presentations.
graphics.reading: Four equal units remain peers while a green path identifies one continuous row-by-row route. Connectors and arrowheads express succession rather than relative size or rank. This is one illustrated route, not a universal reading pattern.

graphics.title: Align to Common Edges
graphics.mechanism: Give related elements shared reference edges so their placement expresses a clear and dependable relationship.
graphics.reading: Three equal-height blocks of different lengths start on the same green reference edge. Their shared origin expresses alignment without implying a complete grid or a hierarchy of sizes.

graphics.title: Establish a Grid
graphics.mechanism: Define reusable margins, tracks, gutters, and spans so layout decisions form a coherent system that can adapt to content and format.
graphics.reading: Four narrow green tracks form one framework. A dark full-width region and two lower two-track regions show different allowed spans. The mark expresses reusable layout relationships, not a requirement that all content occupy identical cells.

graphics.title: Balance Visual Weight
graphics.mechanism: Distribute visual weight across a composition so its parts form an intentional whole while preserving meaningful emphasis.
graphics.reading: A larger open region and a smaller solid region sit on opposite sides of a shared field. Their unequal size and treatment illustrate asymmetric counterpoint, not calibrated visual weights or a rule that a particular pair is numerically balanced.

graphics.title: Establish Visual Rhythm
graphics.mechanism: Coordinate recurring elements and intervals through deliberate repetition, variation and pauses so the composition's pace supports its content.
graphics.reading: Two matching primary-accent pairs recur with a larger interval between them. Repetition, variation and a pause form one readable sequence; no fixed viewing tempo is implied.

graphics.title: Signal Relationships Through Similarity
graphics.mechanism: Give elements that share a meaningful category or role a recognizable visual feature, and avoid sharing that feature where it would imply a false relationship.
graphics.reading: Circles and squares repeat their shared appearance across separated positions. Similarity identifies two feature categories within the same array rather than relying on a single local cluster.

graphics.title: Establish Visual Continuity
graphics.mechanism: Make the position and direction of separated marks support the intended continuation of a path or contour, while preserving meaningful breaks.
graphics.reading: Two visible segments occupy one extended diagonal while a filled panel interrupts the middle. Position and direction support a common continuation through the interruption.

graphics.title: Separate Figure from Ground
graphics.mechanism: Give the content that must read as a distinct object or layer a dependable boundary against its surroundings, using a ground that supports that distinction.
graphics.reading: A compact accent disc has a distinct closed contour against a larger unbroken ink field. The field remains visible around the figure, making their roles distinguishable without adding a shadow.

graphics.title: Use Implied Forms
graphics.mechanism: Leave parts of a visual form undrawn or hidden while retaining enough contour and identifying features for the intended whole to remain recognizable.
graphics.reading: Four retained corners support the interpretation of one square even though the middle edge sections are absent. The accent highlights one contributing fragment rather than a second shape.

graphics.title: Group Elements Within Shared Boundaries
graphics.mechanism: Enclose elements that belong to the same meaningful unit, keeping unrelated elements outside so the visible region expresses the intended membership.
graphics.reading: A single shared outline contains three different marks, while a matching mark outside the region remains separate. Enclosure, rather than visual similarity alone, expresses intended membership.

graphics.title: Match Typeface to Context
graphics.mechanism: Choose a typeface and its appropriate cut for the reader’s task, intended voice, required characters, and actual viewing and production conditions.
graphics.reading: A serifed display letter and a clearly differentiated upright character show that letterforms can be selected for different communication tasks. The accent emphasizes the diagnostic character rather than a universal preferred type category.

graphics.title: Establish a Type Scale
graphics.mechanism: Choose a limited set of type sizes, assign them to recurring text roles, and adapt the relationships to the medium while preserving readable supporting text.
graphics.reading: Three T forms share a baseline while increasing in size, representing a selected vocabulary of reusable text sizes rather than arbitrary local variations or a prescribed numerical ratio.

graphics.title: Control Line Length
graphics.mechanism: Set the width available to prose so lines support the reading task, allowing natural reflow while preserving readable type and accommodating the surrounding layout.
graphics.reading: An accent dimension shows a chosen horizontal measure above bracketed text lines. The line endings vary naturally within the chosen width rather than filling the page or forcing identical lengths.

graphics.title: Adjust Line Spacing
graphics.mechanism: Set the interval between lines to support the reading task, separating lines enough to follow while keeping connected text cohesive.
graphics.reading: Three equal text lines retain their horizontal shape while a vertical dimension marks the interval between baselines. The accent concerns line separation rather than changing letter size.

graphics.title: Apply Optical Alignment
graphics.mechanism: Make small, shape-aware positioning adjustments when numerical alignment leaves visible text edges or centers looking uneven.
graphics.reading: Three text-like rows share a visible edge while a small accent opening mark hangs outside it. The left rule remains a reference; only the mark crosses it.

graphics.title: Adjust Letter Spacing
graphics.mechanism: Adjust spacing across a text run or between a particular pair to suit its letterforms, size and role while preserving coherent words and necessary word boundaries.
graphics.reading: Two letter-like stem forms keep their size while a short accent dimension occupies their internal interval. The adjustment concerns separation within a run, not moving the entire line.
